query: SELECT json_build_object('c_d_grid',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('series',series_name,'subject',subject_name,'coefficient',coefficient,'optional',is_optional) ORDER BY series_name,subject_name) FROM (SELECT sr.name AS series_name,s.name AS subject_name,c.coefficient,c.is_optional FROM public.edutech_coefficients c JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('C','D') AND c.is_verified ORDER BY sr.name,s.name LIMIT 30) q),'a_coefficients_preserved',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.edutech_coefficients c JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('A1','A2') AND c.is_verified),'cd_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.edutech_coefficients c JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('C','D') AND c.is_verified),'optional_lv2_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.edutech_coefficients c JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('C','D') AND s.name IN ('Allemand','Espagnol') AND c.is_optional AND c.coefficient=1)) AS audit LIMIT 1;
